"""Complete external gate receipts; expected diagnostics remain visible."""
import json
import fcntl
import subprocess
import sys
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, canonical, need, pin


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv)>=3, 'named check and explicit command')
    name,command=sys.argv[1],sys.argv[2:]
    path=BASE/'checks.json'
    lock_path=Path('.artifacts/observer-current-publication-20261011/checks.lock')
    lock_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        saved=json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else {}
        need(name not in saved, 'retain first complete check result')
    inputs={str(p):pin(p.read_bytes()) for p in sorted(BASE.glob('*.py'))}
    inputs.update({arg:pin(Path(arg).read_bytes()) for arg in command if Path(arg).is_file()})
    result=subprocess.run(command,capture_output=True,text=True)
    # Commands may run independently; only this short read/merge/write is
    # serialized. Reload after the child so an older invocation cannot erase
    # a receipt completed while it was running.
    with lock_path.open('a+b') as lock:
        fcntl.flock(lock,fcntl.LOCK_EX)
        saved=json.loads(path.read_bytes()) if path.exists() else {}
        need(name not in saved, 'retain first complete check result')
        saved[name]=dict(command=command,status=result.returncode,stdout=result.stdout,stderr=result.stderr,inputs=inputs)
        path.write_bytes(canonical(saved))
    print(name,result.returncode,result.stdout[-1400:],result.stderr[-1800:],flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode==0,'external check success: '+name)

"""Independent first-admission authority for complete observer publication."""
import copy
import gzip
import json
import re
import subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, REPAIR, REVISION, SCOPE, canonical, inputs, load, need, pin, save, same
import prepare

CARD=prepare.CARD
OWNER='SEMANTIC-INTROSPECTION-MCP-FRONTIER.60.4.3.3.5.2.1.5.2.2.3.1.2.1.3.1.2.3.2.3.3.3.3.2.3.2.3.3.2.3.2.2.2.3.5.3'
BEFORE={'bytes':4272,'sha256':'9ff5e9d8edd6953233271bc0659b74429f52921f33d652e2f19e910691c338b0'}
AFTER={'bytes':4267,'sha256':'84ce9b85468778f4335125034692b6d443627e74650b4e83f0bd560f5fdee758'}
REVIEW={'bytes':10567,'sha256':'9ed555955fb6db8a4cb6c1c9c6953cc5c8e0d179ceec1ee4338d3751e20e63ab'}
TASK=Path('docs/tasks/SEMANTIC-INTROSPECTION-MCP-FRONTIER.md')


def frontmatter(raw):
    text=raw.decode();head=text.split('---',2)[1]
    questions=re.findall(r'^  - "(.*)"$',head,re.M)
    return head,questions


def qualify(candidate, before, after, review):
    need(type(candidate) is dict and set(candidate)=={'schema','root','owner','revision','scope','card','question','before','after','review','layout','registry','source_population'},'closed complete observer proposal schema')
    need(candidate['root']=='.' and candidate['card']==CARD,'fixed repository-relative observer source authority')
    need(candidate['schema']=='complete-observer-publication-v1' and candidate['owner']==OWNER and candidate['revision']==REVISION,'fixed unchanged observer publication owner and epoch')
    need(candidate['scope']==SCOPE,'complete finite scope and all unchanged native/private/open successors')
    need(type(before) is bytes and pin(before)==BEFORE==candidate['before']==pin(prepare.git(CARD)),'whole fixed original observer topic')
    need(type(after) is bytes and pin(after)==AFTER==candidate['after'],'whole reviewed target meanings and native uncertainty')
    need(type(review) is dict and pin(canonical(review))==REVIEW==candidate['review'],'whole explicit proposition review')
    need(candidate['question']==prepare.QUESTION,'fixed one broad complete-header question')
    original,old_questions=frontmatter(before);proposed,new_questions=frontmatter(after)
    need(new_questions==old_questions+[prepare.QUESTION],'all original ordered questions and one declared new question')
    # Removing only the declared date, new answer and evidence addition restores
    # the complete original metadata, including every prior replay route.
    restored=proposed.replace('  - "'+prepare.QUESTION+'"\n','',1).replace('date: 2026-10-11\n','date: 2026-10-10\n',1)
    restored=restored.replace('  docs/audits/observer-original-header-join-20261011/proof.json;\n','',1)
    need(restored==original,'whole original metadata evidence and replay routes')
    need(review['rows']==prepare.review(before,after) and review['new_scope']==SCOPE,'every original proposition mapped to complete reviewed text')
    need(all(prepare.metrics(after)[k]<=v for k,v in prepare.metrics(before).items()),'unchanged non-growing card dimensions')
    regenerated,layout=prepare.final_card()
    need(regenerated==after and layout==load('final-layout.json') and pin(canonical(layout))==candidate['layout'],'complete reproducible non-growing layout')
    registry=(BASE/'before-registry.jsonl.txt').read_bytes()
    need(registry==prepare.git(prepare.REGISTRY) and pin(registry)==candidate['registry'],'whole fixed unchanged collection authority')
    compressed=(BASE/'before-canonical.json.gz').read_bytes()
    need(pin(compressed)==candidate['source_population'],'whole retained original canonical population')
    sources=json.loads(gzip.decompress(compressed))
    need(sources[CARD].encode()==before,'whole topic in complete retained source population')
    return dict(before=prepare.metrics(before),after=prepare.metrics(after),scope=SCOPE)


def block(text,identifier):
    marker='- ID: `'+identifier+'`\n';need(text.count(marker)==1,'unique complete observer owner')
    start=text.index(marker);end=text.find('\n- ID:',start+1)
    return text[start:end if end>=0 else len(text)]


def fields(body):
    return {key:re.search(r'^  '+key+r': `(.*)`$',body,re.M).group(1)
            for key in ('Goal','Acceptance','Children') if re.search(r'^  '+key+':',body,re.M)}


def contracts(current=None):
    original=prepare.git(str(TASK)).decode();parent=OWNER.rsplit('.',1)[0];pending=[parent];rows={}
    while pending:
        identifier=pending.pop();body=block(original,identifier);rows[identifier]=body
        pending.extend(re.findall(r'SEMANTIC-INTROSPECTION-MCP-FRONTIER[.0-9]*',fields(body).get('Children','')))
    text=TASK.read_text() if current is None else current
    for identifier,old in rows.items():
        actual=block(text,identifier)
        need(fields(actual)==fields(old),'whole unchanged observer parent and every descendant contract')
        if identifier not in (OWNER,parent):
            need('\n  Status: `done`\n' in actual,'every prerequisite observer descendant complete before publication')
    return dict(revision=REVISION,original_bodies=rows,scope=SCOPE)


def hostile_controls(proposal,before,after,review):
    cases=[]
    def check(name,candidate,b=before,a=after,r=review,cause=None):
        need(not same(candidate,proposal) or b!=before or a!=after or not same(r,review),'genuine first-admission intervention')
        try: qualify(candidate,b,a,r)
        except ValueError as error:
            need(str(error)==cause,'intended independent first-admission refusal: '+name)
            cases.append(dict(name=name,proposal=candidate,before=b.decode(),after=a.decode(),review=r,cause=str(error),status='rejected'))
        else: raise ValueError('accepted hostile first-admission observer publication: '+name)
    for name,key,value,cause in [
        ('foreign-root','root','..','fixed repository-relative observer source authority'),
        ('foreign-card','card','docs/knowledge/borrowed.md','fixed repository-relative observer source authority'),
        ('borrowed-owner','owner',OWNER+'.1','fixed unchanged observer publication owner and epoch'),
        ('narrowed-scope','scope','full native acceptance','complete finite scope and all unchanged native/private/open successors'),
        ('lost-new-question','question','borrowed?','fixed one broad complete-header question')]:
        candidate=copy.deepcopy(proposal);candidate[key]=value;check(name,candidate,cause=cause)
    for name,old,new in [
        ('native-promotion','native identity unmeasured','native identity qualified'),
        ('lost-old-meaning','forwards callback arguments to the body','forwards no arguments to the body'),
        ('lost-old-question','  - "what qualifies original named helper inputs defaults and active paths?"\n',''),
        ('lost-replay','scripts/check_record_value_publication.py','scripts/borrowed.py'),
        ('prefix-only','Complete headers join full source expressions','Prefix headers join selected source expressions')]:
        need(after.count(old.encode())==1,'genuine known complete meaning intervention')
        altered=after.replace(old.encode(),new.encode(),1);candidate=copy.deepcopy(proposal);candidate['after']=pin(altered)
        check(name,candidate,a=altered,cause='whole reviewed target meanings and native uncertainty')
    candidate=copy.deepcopy(proposal);altered=copy.deepcopy(review);altered['rows'].pop();candidate['review']=pin(canonical(altered))
    check('lost-whole-review',candidate,r=altered,cause='whole explicit proposition review')
    return cases


def main():
    proposal=load('proposal.json');before=(BASE/'before-card.md.txt').read_bytes();after=(BASE/'published-card.md.txt').read_bytes();review=load('review.json')
    need(not (BASE/'admission-manifest.json').exists(),'genuine first admission precedes any seal')
    result=qualify(proposal,before,after,review)
    task=contracts();save('contracts.json',task)
    controls=hostile_controls(proposal,before,after,review);save('first-admission-controls.json',controls)
    draft_results=[]
    for draft,receipt in [('first-growing-draft.md.txt','first-draft-refusal.json'),('second-draft.md.txt','second-draft-refusal.json'),('third-draft.md.txt','third-draft-refusal.json')]:
        raw=(BASE/draft).read_bytes();actual=load(receipt)
        need(type(actual['status']) is int and actual['status']==1 and 'AssertionError' in actual['output'],'complete actual refused growing draft')
        need(any(prepare.metrics(raw)[k]>v for k,v in prepare.metrics(before).items()),'actual draft violates unchanged dimensions')
        draft_results.append(dict(draft=draft,dimensions=prepare.metrics(raw),receipt=actual))
    save('model-proof.json',dict(result=result,contracts=pin(canonical(task)),controls=pin(canonical(controls)),
         first_admission_without_prior_seal=True,whole_originals_and_draft_refusals=draft_results))
    print('PASS complete unchanged observer acceptance, explicit non-growing proposition/metadata review and genuine pre-seal hostile proposals; no current publication claimed.')


if __name__=='__main__': main()

"""Prepare full non-growing topic review; no current publication is implied."""
import gzip
import json
import subprocess
import textwrap
from pathlib import Path
from common import BASE, REVISION, SCOPE, canonical, need, pin, save

CARD='docs/knowledge/record-value-original-observer-helper-paths.md'
REGISTRY='doctrine/live_document_size/surfaces.jsonl'
QUESTION='what qualifies complete original observer argument headers?'


def git(path):
    actual=subprocess.run(['git','--no-replace-objects','show',REVISION+':'+path],capture_output=True)
    need(type(actual.returncode) is int and actual.returncode==0 and actual.stderr==b'', 'complete fixed publication beforeimage')
    return actual.stdout


def metrics(raw):
    return dict(bytes=len(raw),lines=raw.count(b'\n'),max_line_bytes=max(map(len,raw.splitlines())))


def paragraphs(raw):
    return raw.decode().split('---',2)[2].strip().split('\n\n')


def final_card():
    initial=(BASE/'after-card.md.txt').read_bytes()
    header=initial.decode().split('---',2)[1]
    body=paragraphs(initial)
    edits={'Complete encoded headers join full source expressions and overlapping frame aliases':
           'Complete headers join full source expressions and frame aliases',
           'Model/member/order/role/kind/family/operand':
           'Model/population/member/order/phase/role/kind/family/operand'}
    words=[' '.join(p.split()) for p in body]
    changed=[]
    for p in words:
        for old,new in edits.items(): p=p.replace(old,new)
        changed.append(p)
    before=(BASE/'before-card.md.txt').read_bytes(); chosen=None
    for width in range(128,metrics(before)['max_line_bytes']+1):
        wrapped=[textwrap.fill(p,width,break_long_words=False,break_on_hyphens=False) for p in changed]
        candidate=('---'+header+'---\n\n'+'\n\n'.join(wrapped)+'\n').encode()
        if all(metrics(candidate)[k]<=v for k,v in metrics(before).items()):
            chosen=(width,candidate,wrapped);break
    need(chosen is not None,'non-growing complete canonical review')
    width,raw,wrapped=chosen
    need(all(' '.join(p.split())==w for p,w in zip(wrapped,changed)),'whole paragraph lexical conservation')
    return raw,dict(before=metrics(before),after=metrics(raw),selected_width=width,
                    declared_edits=edits,whole_paragraph_words=changed)


def review(before,after):
    old=paragraphs(before);new=paragraphs(after)
    # Each whole old paragraph is retained with the complete replacement text.
    # This is a dated engineering review, not an automated language oracle.
    mapping=[([0], 'All API/parser/eval/wrapper/source roles, declared receiver, source graphs, supplied/default inputs, returned builders, parameterless callbacks, regex bodies/labels, both nested throw phases and contiguous source-first order retain. Full conditional grammar is added in replacement paragraph 4; original identity remains unknown.'),
             ([5], 'Core source/address/active-holder and own coordinate qualifications retain. All original private/provider/hook/class/native-address/framework/parser identities, external coordinates, consumer/alias/full-semantic/cold/candidate/permanent/hot/host-native/visual scopes remain unknown or open. Dated full-format uncertainty becomes the explicitly conditional current grammar in paragraph 4, never original settings.'),
             ([6], 'Related canonical replay/probe route retains exactly.'),
             ([], 'The organizational heading adds no independent proposition; complete own-subtest/do-load meanings retain in paragraphs 1 and 2.'),
             ([1], 'Every refusal, authored named body, saved delegate, name/body/extras, wrapper, callback argument and delegate-extra forwarding, empty authored extras/body/own callback and name/CODE kind retain; kind still supplies no callback identity.'),
             ([2], 'Original do-file spelling and error/return capture, diagnostic require distinction, public POD contract, dated current interface qualification and unknown original framework version retain.'),
             ([4,5], 'Dated public prefix/CODE-kind/body/delegate/entry/do-load order qualification remains its historical limited predicate. New complete token contract strictly strengthens it. Opaque receiver/private intervals and native unknowns retain. Every old wrong-name/kind/population/order control is included.'),
             ([3,4], 'All operation/helper/body/public/entry/load class/family/guard/phase/operand roles and original phases retain. Prior predicates still treat inherited operands as opaque without formatter/coordinate/address oracle; opaque own/public false-green versus full forwarding refusal retains. Whole model/member/population/order/phase/role/kind/family/operand/native-promotion controls retain.')]
    return [dict(original_index=i,whole_original=p,replacement_indices=indices,
                 whole_replacements=[new[n] for n in indices],judgment=judgment)
            for i,(p,(indices,judgment)) in enumerate(zip(old,mapping))]


def main():
    before=git(CARD); need(before==(BASE/'before-card.md.txt').read_bytes()==Path(CARD).read_bytes(),'whole fixed and still-current topic before publication')
    after,layout=final_card()
    (BASE/'published-card.md.txt').write_bytes(after)
    save('final-layout.json',layout)
    fixed={}
    for root in ('docs/knowledge','docs/decisions'):
        for path in sorted(Path(root).rglob('*.md')):
            need(not path.is_symlink(),'same-volume ordinary canonical source')
            fixed[str(path)]=path.read_text()
    need(fixed[CARD].encode()==before,'complete global topic beforeimage')
    (BASE/'before-canonical.json.gz').write_bytes(gzip.compress(canonical(fixed),mtime=0))
    (BASE/'before-registry.jsonl.txt').write_bytes(git(REGISTRY))
    save('review.json',dict(kind='explicit whole-proposition engineering review; no language oracle',
         rows=review(before,after),retained_probes=['scripts/run_with_ram_guard.sh -- python3 -B scripts/check_record_value_publication.py',
         'record-value-finite-copy-probe-reader'],new_scope=SCOPE))
    save('proposal.json',dict(schema='complete-observer-publication-v1',root='.',owner=(BASE/'scope.txt').read_text().splitlines()[0],
         revision=REVISION,scope=SCOPE,card=CARD,question=QUESTION,before=pin(before),after=pin(after),
         review=pin((BASE/'review.json').read_bytes()),layout=pin((BASE/'final-layout.json').read_bytes()),
         registry=pin(git(REGISTRY)),source_population=pin((BASE/'before-canonical.json.gz').read_bytes())))
    print('PASS complete fixed beforeimages and explicit non-growing topic review prepared; live card untouched.')


if __name__=='__main__': main()

            receipt='actual-prerequisite-'+name+'-1.json',identity=pin(canonical(actual)))

"""Retain every actual command, stream and complete program epoch, including failures."""
import subprocess
import sys
from common import BASE, canonical, need, pin, save


def execute(label, command):
    previous = list(BASE.glob('actual-' + label + '-*.json'))
    name = 'actual-' + label + '-' + str(len(previous) + 1) + '.json'
    programs = {str(p):dict(identity=pin(p.read_bytes()), body=p.read_text())
                for p in sorted(BASE.iterdir()) if p.suffix in ('.py', '.pl')}
    result = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True)
    record = dict(command=command, status=result.returncode, stdout=result.stdout,
                  stderr=result.stderr, programs=programs)
    save(name, record)
    print(name, result.returncode, result.stdout[-500:], result.stderr[-1000:], flush=True)
    need(type(result.returncode) is int and result.returncode == 0 and not result.stderr,
         'actual complete successful step: ' + name)
    return record


if __name__ == '__main__':
    need(len(sys.argv) >= 3, 'label and explicit command required')
    execute(sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:])
